# Generated by ppc worldbuilder (raw_material_placement.py) from vanilla columbian_exchange.txt; do not edit by hand.
# Prosper or Perish places raw materials itself: the goods carry no location_potential (EU5 1.4), so the two
# move-good actions test the mod's placement rules (scripted_triggers/pp_raw_material_placement.txt) instead of
# is_goods_valid_for_location, refresh the RGO bonus right after change_raw_material, and teach the acting country
# to farm a gated crop it planted outside its native lands. Everything else is vanilla's.

TRY_REPLACE:move_nw_good_to_new_location = {
	type = situation

	ai_tick = monthly
	ai_tick_frequency = 60
	automation_tick = never
	automation_tick_frequency = 12

	maximum_targets_in_one_tick = 20
	disallowed_duplicates_of_targets_for_ai = { target_location }

	potential = {
	}

	allow = {
		scope:actor ?= {
			any_market_present_in_country = {
				has_new_world_goods_in_market = yes
			}
		}
	}
	
	price = price:move_good_to_new_location

	select_trigger = {
		looking_for_a = situation
		target_flag = recipient
		name = "choose_situation"
		column = { data = name }
		visible = {
			situation:columbian_exchange = this
			situation_is_active = yes
		}
	}

	
	#goods in scope:goods
	select_trigger = {
		looking_for_a = goods
		target_flag = target_good
		ai_interaction_source_list = {# Has a market that demands the good
			every_goods = {
				limit = {
					has_origin_in_new_world = yes
				}
				save_temporary_scope_as = temp_good

				scope:actor = { 
					random_market_present_in_country = {
						limit = {
							"goods_demand_in_market(scope:temp_good)" > "goods_supply_in_market(scope:temp_good)"
						}
						scope:temp_good = { 
							add_to_list = source							
							#If the good is food, double the chances of it being chosen
							if = {
								limit = {
									is_food = yes
								}
								add_to_list = source	
							}
						}
					}
				}
			}
		}
		name = "spread_select_goods"
		none_available_msg_key = "move_nw_good_to_new_location_no_available_good"
		column = { data = name }
		visible = {
			has_origin_in_new_world = yes
			scope:actor ?= {
				any_market_present_in_country = {
					OR = {
						is_produced_in_market = root
						is_traded_in_market = root
					}
				}
			}
		}
	}
	
	#Select Region
	select_trigger = {
		looking_for_a = region
		source = actor
		target_flag = target_region
		name = "choose_a_region"
		none_available_msg_key = "no_regions_available"
		column = { data = name }
		visible = {
			scope:actor = {
				owns_or_has_subject_in = prev
			}
		}
	}
	
	#Select the owned location where to spread the new resource
	select_trigger = {
		looking_for_a = location
		source = target_region
		source_flags = only_actual_locations
		target_flag = target_location
		ai_interaction_source_list = {
			scope:target_region = {
				every_area_in_region = {
					limit = {
						scope:actor = { owns_or_has_subject_in = prev }
					}
					every_province_definition_in_area = {						
						limit = {
							scope:actor = { owns_or_has_subject_in = prev }
							#Maximum of 2 of the same resource per Province
							"raw_material_amount(scope:target_good)" < 2
						}
						every_ownable_location_in_province_definition = {
							limit = {
								owner ?= {
									is_subject_or_below_of = scope:actor
								}
								is_candidate_for_NW_good = yes
								NOT = {raw_material ?= scope:target_good}								
							}
							add_to_list = source
						}
					}
				}
			}
		}
		name = "choose_location"
		none_available_msg_key = "move_nw_good_to_new_location_no_available_location"
		column = { data = name }
		column = { data = raw_material }
		column = { data = population }
		visible = {
			is_ownable = yes
			has_owner = yes
			OR = {
				owner ?= scope:actor
				top_owner ?= scope:actor
			}
			NOT = { raw_material ?= scope:target_good }
			# Prosper or Perish: the mod's placement rules (pp_raw_material_placement.txt), not the goods' location_potential
			trigger_if = {
				limit = { scope:target_good ?= goods:tobacco }
				pp_tobacco_placement_location = yes
			}
			trigger_if = {
				limit = { scope:target_good ?= goods:cocoa }
				pp_cocoa_placement_location = yes
			}
			trigger_if = {
				limit = { scope:target_good ?= goods:maize }
				pp_maize_placement_location = yes
			}
			trigger_if = {
				limit = { scope:target_good ?= goods:chili }
				pp_chili_placement_location = yes
			}
			trigger_if = {
				limit = { scope:target_good ?= goods:potato }
				pp_potato_placement_location = yes
			}
		}
	}

	effect = {
		scope:target_location ?= {			
			change_max_raw_material_workers = {
				value = rgo_workers
				subtract = 1
				min = 0
				multiply = -1
			}
			change_prosperity = prosperity_weak_penalty
			change_raw_material = scope:target_good
			pp_refresh_rgo_static_bonus = yes
			pp_refresh_fruit_orchard_eligibility = yes
		}
		# a gated crop planted outside its native lands teaches the acting country to farm it (unless it already knows how)
		scope:actor ?= {
			if = {
				limit = {
					scope:target_good = goods:maize
					NOR = {
						has_advance = pp_maize_farm_advance_general
						pp_maize_native_country = yes
					}
				}
				research_advance = advance_type:pp_maize_farm_advance_general
			}
			if = {
				limit = {
					scope:target_good = goods:potato
					NOR = {
						has_advance = pp_potato_farm_advance_general
						pp_potato_native_country = yes
					}
				}
				research_advance = advance_type:pp_potato_farm_advance_general
			}
		}
	}
	
	ai_will_do = {
		value = -1 #Bias against doing anything
		#scope:target_good, scope:target_location
		if = {
			limit = {
				exists = scope:target_good
				exists = scope:target_location
			}
			scope:target_good = {
				#We try to keep expensive resources
				add = "price_in_market(scope:target_location.market)"
				scope:target_location.raw_material = {
					subtract = "price_in_market(scope:target_location.market)"
				}
				#Multiply the price result to make the action more common if positive
				multiply = 10
				#If there is surplus is less valuable
				if = {
					limit = {
						is_in_surplus_in_market = { market = scope:target_location.market country = scope:actor value > 0 }
					}
					subtract = 	100
				}
				#If the good is food
				if = {
					limit = {
						is_food = yes
					}
					subtract = scope:target_good.food_value
					add = scope:target_location.raw_material.food_value
				}

			}
		}
	}
}

TRY_REPLACE:move_ow_good_to_new_location = {
	type = situation

	ai_tick = monthly
	ai_tick_frequency = 12
	automation_tick = never
	automation_tick_frequency = 12

	maximum_targets_in_one_tick = 20
	disallowed_duplicates_of_targets_for_ai = { target_location }

	potential = {
	}

	allow = {
		scope:actor ?= {
			any_market_present_in_country = {
				has_old_world_goods_in_market = yes
			}
		}
	}
	
	price = price:move_good_to_new_location

	select_trigger = {
		looking_for_a = situation
		target_flag = recipient
		name = "choose_situation"
		column = { data = name }
		visible = {
			situation:columbian_exchange = this
			situation_is_active = yes
		}
	}

	#goods in scope:goods
	select_trigger = {
		looking_for_a = goods
		target_flag = target_good
		ai_interaction_source_list = {# Has a market that demands the good
			every_goods = {
				limit = {
					has_origin_in_old_world = yes
				}
				save_temporary_scope_as = temp_good
				scope:actor = { 
					random_market_present_in_country = {
						limit = {
							"goods_demand_in_market(scope:temp_good)" > "goods_supply_in_market(scope:temp_good)"
						}
						scope:temp_good = { 
							add_to_list = source							
							#If the good is food, double the chances of it being chosen
							if = {
								limit = {
									is_food = yes
								}
								add_to_list = source	
							}
						}
					}
				}
			}
		}
		name = "spread_select_goods"
		none_available_msg_key = "move_ow_good_to_new_location_no_available_good"
		column = { data = name }
		visible = {
			has_origin_in_old_world = yes
		}
	}

	#Select Region
	select_trigger = {
		looking_for_a = region
		source = actor
		target_flag = target_region
		name = "choose_a_region"
		none_available_msg_key = "no_regions_available"
		column = { data = name }
		visible = {
			OR = {
				continent = continent:america
				continent = continent:oceania
				this = region:macaronesia_region
			}
			scope:actor = {
				owns_or_has_subject_in = prev
			}
		}
	}
	#Select the owned location where to spread the new resource
	select_trigger = {
		looking_for_a = location
		source = target_region
		source_flags = only_actual_locations
		target_flag = target_location
		ai_interaction_source_list = {
			scope:target_region = {
				every_area_in_region = {
					limit = {
						scope:actor = { owns_or_has_subject_in = prev }
					}
					every_province_definition_in_area = {						
						limit = {
							scope:actor = { owns_or_has_subject_in = prev }
							#Maximum of 2 of the same resource per Province
							"raw_material_amount(scope:target_good)" < 2
						}
						every_ownable_location_in_province_definition = {
							limit = {
								owner ?= {
									is_subject_or_below_of = scope:actor
								}
								is_candidate_for_OW_good = yes
								NOT = {raw_material ?= scope:target_good}								
							}
							add_to_list = source
						}
					}
				}
			}
		}
		name = "choose_location"
		none_available_msg_key = "move_ow_good_to_new_location_no_available_location"
		column = { data = name }
		column = { data = raw_material }
		column = { data = population }
		visible = {
			is_ownable = yes
			has_owner = yes
			OR = {
				owner ?= scope:actor
				top_owner ?= scope:actor
			}
			OR = {
				continent = continent:america
				continent = continent:oceania
				region = region:macaronesia_region
			}
			NOT = { raw_material ?= scope:target_good }
			# Prosper or Perish: the mod's placement rules (pp_raw_material_placement.txt), not the goods' location_potential
			trigger_if = {
				limit = { scope:target_good ?= goods:cotton }
				pp_cotton_placement_location = yes
			}
			trigger_if = {
				limit = { scope:target_good ?= goods:wheat }
				pp_wheat_placement_location = yes
			}
			trigger_if = {
				limit = { scope:target_good ?= goods:millet }
				pp_millet_placement_location = yes
			}
			trigger_if = {
				limit = { scope:target_good ?= goods:olives }
				pp_olives_placement_location = yes
			}
			trigger_if = {
				limit = { scope:target_good ?= goods:coffee }
				pp_coffee_placement_location = yes
			}
			trigger_if = {
				limit = { scope:target_good ?= goods:rice }
				pp_rice_placement_location = yes
			}
			trigger_if = {
				limit = { scope:target_good ?= goods:sugar }
				pp_sugar_placement_location = yes
			}
			trigger_if = {
				limit = { scope:target_good ?= goods:wine }
				pp_wine_placement_location = yes
			}
			trigger_if = {
				limit = { scope:target_good ?= goods:horses }
				pp_horses_placement_location = yes
			}
			trigger_if = {
				limit = { scope:target_good ?= goods:wool }
				pp_wool_placement_location = yes
			}
			trigger_if = {
				limit = { scope:target_good ?= goods:livestock }
				pp_livestock_placement_location = yes
			}
			trigger_if = {
				limit = { scope:target_good ?= goods:saffron }
				pp_saffron_placement_location = yes
			}
			trigger_if = {
				limit = { scope:target_good ?= goods:pepper }
				pp_pepper_placement_location = yes
			}
			trigger_if = {
				limit = { scope:target_good ?= goods:cloves }
				pp_cloves_placement_location = yes
			}
			trigger_if = {
				limit = { scope:target_good ?= goods:beeswax }
				pp_beeswax_placement_location = yes
			}
		}
	}

	effect = {
		scope:target_location ?= {			
			change_max_raw_material_workers = {
				value = rgo_workers
				subtract = 1
				min = 0
				multiply = -1
			}
			change_prosperity = prosperity_weak_penalty
			change_raw_material = scope:target_good
			pp_refresh_rgo_static_bonus = yes
			pp_refresh_fruit_orchard_eligibility = yes
		}
		# a gated crop planted outside its native lands teaches the acting country to farm it (unless it already knows how)
		scope:actor ?= {
			if = {
				limit = {
					scope:target_good = goods:rice
					NOR = {
						has_advance = pp_rice_farm_advance_general
						pp_rice_native_country = yes
					}
				}
				research_advance = advance_type:pp_rice_farm_advance_general
			}
			if = {
				limit = {
					scope:target_good = goods:olives
					NOR = {
						has_advance = pp_olives_farm_advance_general
						pp_olive_native_country = yes
					}
				}
				research_advance = advance_type:pp_olives_farm_advance_general
			}
		}
	}
	
	ai_will_do = {
		#If the action is doable by the AI, 
		#meaning there is a combination of target good and target location where it can replace the RGO it should do it
		add = 200
	}
}
